title: How It Works
subtitle: A 4-step AI-powered triage pipeline, from symptom to recommendation.

1.title: 1. Describe Your Symptoms
1.description: You start by describing what's bothering you — in your own words, just like you would to a real doctor. No forms, no checkboxes.

2.title: 2. AI Follow-Up Questions
2.description: The AI analyzes your description and asks clarifying follow-up questions, just like a triage nurse would. Up to 3 rounds of Q&A.

3.title: 3. Triage Recommendation
3.description: When the AI has enough information, it produces a recommendation: which specialist you should see, how urgent it is, and why.

4.title: 4. Review & Next Steps
4.description: You can review your full conversation history and the triage outcome. The system is transparent — you see exactly what the AI saw.

disclaimer: Remember: this is a demo. Not real medical advice. See our Terms of Service for details.
